chunks: And Yūnus ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated it, raising it to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
The owners of livestock are not liable for anything so long as the animals are left roaming freely.

key_terms.بَهِيمَةُ الْأَنْعَامِ: grazing livestock or domesticated pasture animals
key_terms.مُرْسَلَةً: left loose or allowed to roam freely
key_terms.يَغْرَمُ: to be liable or financially responsible

ai.seo_question: Are the owners of livestock liable for damage caused while the animals are roaming freely?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning liability for damage caused by grazing livestock. It states that the owners are not held financially responsible as long as the animals were left roaming freely in the normal manner.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5350 - Yunus ibn Abd Al-Rahman narrated, raising it to Abu Abdullah (as), who said:
"The owners of livestock are not liable for anything as long as the animals are left to roam freely."
